_comment: Postal Rulings config. Paste your Apps Script Web app URL (ending in /exec) as the endpoint, save, and upload this file next to index.html. No rebuild needed. Leave empty for sample data.
_comment_signin: Optional. Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials > Create credentials > OAuth client ID > Web application. Add your site origin (e.g. https://uvsubbaiah-spec.github.io) under Authorised JavaScript origins. Paste the client ID below to offer readers one-tap Google sign-in: it records their verified name and email with no typing. Leave empty to keep the app fully anonymous.
